**CHR-1047 — Agent skill section of the Connect AI tools dialog** (epic CHR-1045). Status: draft, design-reviewer round 1 fixed, waiting for Christian's approval. Build ticket: CHR-1048.

## Goal
The user sees what the artisign agent skill does, can **read SKILL.md before installing**, copies `artisign setup --skill`, and sees per AI tool whether the skill is there. **Copy-only:** the preview never installs or writes a file (CHR-1045 decision 1).

## Screens
| Screen | Kind | What |
|---|---|---|
| `shell-mcp-setup-dialog` | parent (changed) | tab strip added; MCP server tab active; missing tool now reads "Not found" |
| `shell-mcp-setup-dialog-skill` (+ `-dark`) | state of parent | Agent skill tab, mixed statuses |
| `shell-mcp-setup-dialog-skill-reader` (+ `-dark`) | step of skill | SKILL.md reader |
| `shell-mcp-setup-dialog-skill-all-installed` (+ `-dark`) | state of skill | every tool has the current skill |
| `shell-mcp-setup-dialog-skill-status-unavailable` (+ `-dark`) | state of skill | status could not be read; loading described in its notes |

Flows: MCP server tab ↔ Agent skill tab, Read SKILL.md → reader, reader Back / arrow → tab, Done → settings menu.

## Decisions
1. **Tabs, not one long dialog.** "MCP server" | "Agent skill" (`chrome-tab`). A second stacked section would make the dialog ~1000px tall in a 900px viewport and force scrolling inside a modal; tabs keep each view at today's size and keep the approved MCP content unchanged. Cost: the skill is one click away. The dialog opens on MCP server.
2. **Reader as a step, not an inline expander.** The dialog content swaps to the reader (640px wide, fixed 560px scroll area) with Back. An inline expander would have to share the 560px dialog with the command and the tool list and would leave ~250px for reading. Step keeps one modal and one scrim.
3. **Skill statuses**, `chrome-status-chip` variants: Installed (ok), Outdated (warning), Not installed (outlined, = skill missing).
4. **"Not found" in both tabs** (Christian, 2026-11-13): a tool that is not on this machine reads "Not found" (`not-found`, muted, row dimmed) in the MCP server tab AND the Agent skill tab. The approved MCP tab's former "Not installed" label for a missing tool is replaced; the variant `not-installed` is retired. Light and dark follow (the chip is theme-agnostic).
5. **Claude Desktop** has no skills folder: no chip, `secondary-compact` "Copy SKILL.md" and "Download" in its row, plus a caption under the list in `text-secondary` (Christian: contrast). Footer summary and the other tertiary text stay tertiary.
6. **No per-row actions for the other tools.** One command fixes every row (install and update), so rows do not expand; there is no chevron column in this tab.
7. Outdated is shown, not explained per row: `artisign setup --skill` (and `artisign update`) refreshes it.

## Data (from CHR-1046)
`GET /api/setup` → `skill: { command, content, clients: [{ name, status, path }] }`.
- `installed` → `installed`, `outdated` → `outdated`, `missing` → `skill-not-installed`, `unsupported` → Claude Desktop's Copy / Download.
- A tool that the MCP part of the same response reports as not found (`found: false`) → `not-found` (row dimmed), whatever the skill status.
- **Footer formula:** "N of M tools have the current skill". **M = tools found on the machine that have a skills folder** (Claude Desktop and not-found tools do not count); **N = those with status Installed**. Drawn: "2 of 4". When N = M: "All M tools have the current skill".
- `content` feeds the reader, Copy and Download (file name `SKILL.md`). No `skill` field (older daemon) or a failed request → status-unavailable state. Loading → same layout with "Checking installed tools…".

## Build notes
- **Tabs must not jump.** The skill tab, the reader and the unavailable state have different heights. Anchor the dialog at a fixed top offset (do not re-centre vertically when content changes) or give the dialog body a min-height equal to the tallest tab view, so the title and tab strip stay in place when switching tabs or states.
- **Strip the SKILL.md frontmatter** (the leading `---` … `---` YAML block) from `content` before rendering it with `src/preview/markdown.js`. Copy and Download keep the full file including frontmatter.
- Copy buttons use `src/preview/clipboard.js`; the code-field copy icon turns into `check` for ~1.5s (as in the MCP tab); "Copy SKILL.md" buttons read "Copied" for ~1.5s.
- Statuses are read when the dialog opens; no polling.
- Tabs: `role=tablist/tab`, arrow keys switch; the reader body is focusable (`tabindex=0`) so it scrolls by keyboard. Esc closes the dialog from every view.

## Open points for review
- The dark `chrome-border` hairline is faint on `chrome-raised` (card, list and reader frame outlines). Kept as is for consistency with the approved dark dialogs (`chrome-c-dialog-dark`); a token change would belong to its own ticket.
- Claude Desktop's exact upload menu path is not named in the caption (it changes between versions).
